description: Load each route several times cold in Chromium, throttled like a mid-range phone on slow 4G (or unthrottled with profile desktop), and rank what slows it down by impact and fix risk: LCP image problems, oversized images, render-blocking files, functions that hold the main thread, unused code, fonts, layout-shift causes, slow or chained or duplicate API calls, N+1, third parties by vendor. Each fix names its culprit (selector, URL, or file:line and function). Compares with the previous perf run: a route that got faster only because content went away is a cover-up. Returns perf.md and the perf sheet. Measure a production build.

baseline.description: Perf run to compare with: auto (default), none, or a run directory.

out.description: Output directory. Default .mantis in the server's working directory.

profile.description: mobile (default: 4x slower CPU, slow 4G) or desktop (no throttling).

routes.description: Routes to visit, e.g. ["/", "/settings"]. Default: the path of url.

runs.description: Cold visits per route; the median is reported. Default 3 here (5 on the CLI).

storageState.description: A Playwright storage state JSON file (cookies and localStorage) for pages behind a login. Keep it out of git.

url.description: The page to check, e.g. http://localhost:3000. Routes are resolved against it.

name: mantis_perf
title: Measure speed
